title: Fixed Roller Pillow and Fanned Bobbin Lace Frame
description: One newly authored complete roller-pillow lace-working apparatus in a fixed illustrative pose. Two long finite feet and cross rails carry two end standards, a continuous transverse shaft and a thick softly rounded horizontal roll pillow. A small pin field rises from the crown; twelve continuous solid thread lines fan down toward complete turned wooden bobbins, each with a neck, shoulder and long grip. A low front catch board belongs to the same support frame. Unlike the old seamed pin cushion this is not a cushion-and-loose-pins kit: the roller, bearing frame and suspended connected bobbins define one whole apparatus. Unlike the full floor loom there is no fore/aft warp-cloth pair, heddle castle, reed beater or treadle system. All visible geometry newly authored, no extracted old cushion or loom mesh. Four opaque constant PBR materials, metres, native Z up and horizontal full-bounds-centred ground origin. One complete static prop zero scenes. Thread and pin layout is an illustrative frozen arrangement, not a verified lace pattern, weaving sequence, tension equilibrium, rotating mechanism, ergonomic tool or safe functional apparatus. No cloth, rigging, animation, interaction, sharpness or performance claim.
